actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game animation frame. Draw exactly ONE newly drawn full-body frame of original 04_mountain_guardian_boy, NORTHWEST walk frame 02 of a 16-frame cycle, on one square canvas. No sheet or repeated figures.

Use the images just shown as visual references. Reference 1, the full original portrait, locks identity, costume, palette and equipment only, not its front-facing camera. Reference 2 has NW01 on the LEFT and NW13 on the RIGHT. Reference 3 has NW09 on the LEFT and NW05 on the RIGHT. References 2 and 3 lock the NORTHWEST BACK THREE-QUARTER camera and anatomical scale; do not reproduce their two-column layout or any existing pose.

Face and travel diagonally AWAY toward screen UP-LEFT. Show the rounded brown back of the head, high ponytail with pale green ribbons, left ear and narrow cheek edge only: no visible eye, smile, forehead emblem or front face. Tiny stocky body, wooden beads across the nape, ochre cloud-trim back robe, ivory sleeves and short puffy trousers, green braided belt, brown/gold boots with green ankle ties. Anatomical LEFT shield and its single gold shoulder pauldron stay screen LEFT, the NEAR side. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the upright ring-headed staff screen RIGHT, the FAR side. Preserve all original gear and ornament; never swap or mirror sides.

Pose NW02: one quarter of the transition from NW01 to NW05. The near screen-left SHIELD-SIDE LEFT boot remains flat, planted forward toward up-left, and its knee yields very slightly as it accepts weight. The far screen-right STAFF-SIDE RIGHT foot still trails toward down-right; peel its heel just off the ground while its toe alone still touches. Show only a narrow sliver of that boot sole, not a fully raised boot. Keep the near supporting thigh in front at the overlap. This is a small loaded heel-peel phase, distinctly after NW01 and well before the suspended bent leg of NW05. Exactly two solid legs and boots; head and pelvis stay centered.

Keep the reference head-to-body ratio, body volume and camera distance. Full standing-equivalent silhouette fills about 88-90% of the square height, with at least 5% clear margin on every edge. Keep hair, ribbons, staff tip, shield and tassels fully inside; staff tip and tassels stay above the planted-foot baseline. Only slight gait compression and attached cloth motion, no whole-body travel or per-pose zoom. Intended processing uses the same 0.84 whole-cell common scale as the preserved NW anchors; do not shrink the character or imitate the small reference pixel grid.

Request native 2048x2048 at highest available native visual fidelity, crisp clean hand-painted hair strands, back-robe trim, braided cords, boot edges and metal carving. Actual native single-person cell must be at least 1024 pixels on both axes and will be checked separately. Draw new detail; no upscaling, collage, copied pose, mirrored pose, pixel art or sharpening halo.

Background perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF magenta. Foreground opaque with natural antialiasing. No ground or shadow, detached effects, ghost boots, extra limbs, duplicate outlines, transparency through clothing, checkerboard, labels, border, divider or watermark.
